Market today: The Fed hinting at steady rates is a tailwind for your tech/chip names, but underlying China risks in AI and general economic "trip wires" keep things cautious. AI M&A news is positive.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.02%) and SPAL (-33.32%) are leveraged and deeply underwater, demanding immediate attention. SMH (-13.94%) is also a concern, nearing its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on Fed commentary for continued rate stability and any escalation of US-China tech tensions impacting AI/chips.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, losing positions to protect your capital.
plays: Cut SPAL: It's a new, leveraged position already trading well below its stop of 21.38. Exit to prevent further decay.
Trim SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down nearly 60%. Consider a significant trim to reduce exposure to its decay and extreme volatility.
Watch SMH: It's a TRIM status and nearing its stop of 540. Be ready to act if it breaks that level.
